title: Require a stop contract on repeating graph steps
narrative: A repeating repair step without an explicit stop rule must fail validation before it can loop unbounded. Accepts inspiration requirement 4[^insp-r04]. Complements `fangore_insp_linkage_preflight` and `fangore_convergence_ceiling`.
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/missing_stop.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
